title: Wave 1 release v003: derive cluster assignment for any service
notes: The generated traffic module assigned synthetic clusters from a hardcoded per-repository offset map containing only the three pre-campaign services. Any newly introduced service threw 'Invalid cluster input.' on its first evaluation, so the v002 evaluators for demo-catalog and demo-search crash-looped without ever recording an evaluation.

v003 derives the offset deterministically from the service name and keeps the three original offsets byte-identical, so demo-orders, demo-storefront, and demo-profile retain their existing cluster distribution and their accumulated context history stays comparable.

Found by deploying rather than by reading the code. The evaluators were started, observed failing, and the cause traced from their logs — which is the whole reason Wave 1 deploys before the rollout steps depend on it.
